notes: Vaulty actually converses now: greetings, 'how are we', thanks, jokes and small talk get real replies in his voice — in guide mode and with the AI loaded — and the don't-know card with its research buttons is reserved for factual questions research genuinely couldn't answer. The AI download is now one-time BY LAW: Vaulty checks the model cache itself, so app updates can never ask you to download it again; a different brain is only ever an optional offer, and if your phone clears the download for space he says exactly that, once. The AI also runs on ANY device whose GPU passes a real check — iPhone included, no platform bans — with a crash-loop safety that turns it off rather than ever looping. Plus a new 🌡 AI performance panel (Cool & quiet / Balanced / Max power, reply length, context, model and battery knobs) whose settings save on your device and survive updates.
